description.en: English tenses - present, past and future forms with time markers and common errors asked in Assam competitive exams.
description.as: ইংৰাজী কাল (Tenses) — বৰ্তমান, অতীত আৰু ভৱিষ্যত কালৰ ৰূপ, সময়সূচক শব্দ আৰু অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাত অহা সাধাৰণ ভুল।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ to school every day.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ to school every day.'

a.en: 'Every day' shows a habit, so we use the simple present. With 'she' we add 's/es'.
a.as: 'every day' অভ্যাস বুজায়, গতিকে simple present হয়। 'she'ৰ লগত 's/es' যোগ হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The sun ___ in the east.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The sun ___ in the east.'

a.en: A universal truth is always in the simple present tense.
a.as: সৰ্বকালীন সত্য সদায় simple present tenseত থাকে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Look! It ___ (rain) now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'Look! It ___ (rain) now.'

a.en: An action happening now uses the present continuous (is + ing).
a.as: এতিয়া চলি থকা কাৰ্য present continuous (is + ing)ত হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (cook) dinner at present.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (cook) dinner at present.'

a.en: 'At present' indicates an action going on now, so present continuous.
a.as: 'at present' এতিয়া চলি থকা কাৰ্য বুজায়, গতিকে present continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (finish) my homework just now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (finish) my homework just now.'

a.en: 'Just' suggests a recently completed action, so we use the present perfect.
a.as: 'just'য়ে শেহতীয়াকৈ সম্পন্ন কাৰ্য বুজায়, গতিকে present perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (live) here since 2005.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (live) here since 2005.'

a.en: 'Since + a point of time' with an action still continuing takes the present perfect.
a.as: 'since + সময়ৰ বিন্দু' থাকিলে এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (play) cricket for two hours.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (play) cricket for two hours.'

a.en: 'For + a period' with an action started in the past and still going on takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'for + সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য' আৰু অতীতত আৰম্ভ হৈ এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (visit) my uncle last week.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (visit) my uncle last week.'

a.en: 'Last week' is a finished past time, so we use the simple past.
a.as: 'last week' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The baby ___ (cry) when I came in.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The baby ___ (cry) when I came in.'

a.en: An action going on when another past action happened uses the past continuous.
a.as: অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্যৰ সময়ত চলি থকা কাৰ্য past continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The train ___ (leave) before we reached the station.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The train ___ (leave) before we reached the station.'

a.en: An action completed before another past action takes the past perfect.
a.as: অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্যৰ আগত সম্পন্ন হোৱা কাৰ্য past perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (work) for three hours before the boss came.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (work) for three hours before the boss came.'

a.en: An action continuing up to a past point uses the past perfect continuous.
a.as: অতীতৰ কোনো সময়লৈকে চলি থকা কাৰ্য past perfect continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (call) you tomorrow.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (call) you tomorrow.'

a.en: 'Tomorrow' indicates a future action, so we use 'will + verb'.
a.as: 'tomorrow' ভৱিষ্যত বুজায়, গতিকে 'will + verb' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (finish) the work by evening.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (finish) the work by evening.'

a.en: 'By + a future time' showing completion takes the future perfect.
a.as: 'by + ভৱিষ্যত সময়'ত সম্পন্নতা বুজালে future perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'This time next week I ___ (travel) to Delhi.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'This time next week I ___ (travel) to Delhi.'

a.en: An action in progress at a certain future time uses the future continuous.
a.as: ভৱিষ্যতৰ নিৰ্দিষ্ট সময়ত চলি থকা কাৰ্য future continuous হয়।

q.en: 'Since morning' is a marker mainly used with which tense?
q.as: 'since morning' মূলত কোন কালৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?

a.en: 'Since + a starting point' is typical of the present perfect / present perfect continuous tense.
a.as: 'since + আৰম্ভণি বিন্দু' present perfect / present perfect continuous ৰ বৈশিষ্ট্যপূৰ্ণ।

q.en: 'Yesterday' is a marker mainly used with which tense?
q.as: 'yesterday' মূলত কোন কালৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?

a.en: 'Yesterday' points to a finished past time, so the simple past is used.
a.as: 'yesterday' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়লৈ নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে simple past হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I met him two days ___.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I met him two days ___.'

a.en: 'Ago' is used with a past time and the simple past tense.
a.as: 'ago' অতীত সময় আৰু simple past tenseৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She has been working here ___ 2019.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She has been working here ___ 2019.'

a.en: A point of time (2019) takes 'since' in the present perfect.
a.as: সময়ৰ বিন্দু (২০১৯) present perfectত 'since' লয়।

q.en: Which verb does not take the continuous form?
q.as: কোনটো ক্রিয়া continuous ৰূপ নলয়?

a.en: 'Know' is a stative verb (state, not action), so we say 'I know', not 'I am knowing'.
a.as: 'know' এটা stative (অৱস্থাবোধক) ক্রিয়া; 'I know' হয়, 'I am knowing' নহয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (know) the answer to this question.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (know) the answer to this question.'

a.en: Stative verbs like 'know' are not used in the continuous form.
a.as: 'know'ৰ দৰে stative ক্রিয়া continuous ৰূপত নহয়।

q.en: 'Every day' is a marker mainly used with which tense?
q.as: 'every day' মূলত কোন কালৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?

a.en: 'Every day' shows a routine, so the simple present tense is used.
a.as: 'every day' নিয়মীয়া কাম বুজায়, গতিকে simple present হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The earth ___ round the sun.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The earth ___ round the sun.'

a.en: Scientific truths are expressed in the simple present tense.
a.as: বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য simple present tenseত প্ৰকাশ হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (see) him yesterday.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (see) him yesterday.'

a.en: 'Yesterday' takes the simple past. The past of 'see' is 'saw'.
a.as: 'yesterday' simple past হয়। 'see'ৰ অতীত 'saw'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (not, go) to Guwahati last month.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (not, go) to Guwahati last month.'

a.en: The negative of the simple past is made with 'did not + base verb'.
a.as: simple pastৰ নেতিবাচক ৰূপ 'did not + মূল ক্রিয়া'ৰে হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ you ___ (eat) your breakfast yet?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: '___ you ___ (eat) your breakfast yet?'

a.en: 'Yet' is used with the present perfect: 'Have + past participle'.
a.as: 'yet' present perfectৰ লগত হয়: 'Have + past participle'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.'

a.en: An action in progress in the past when another action interrupted it uses the past continuous.
a.as: অতীতত চলি থকা কাৰ্যত আন কাৰ্যই বাধা দিলে past continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'When I reached the hall, he ___ (already, leave).'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'When I reached the hall, he ___ (already, leave).'

a.en: An action that happened before another past action is in the past perfect.
a.as: অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্যৰ আগত হোৱা কাৰ্য past perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'By next year I ___ (graduate).'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'By next year I ___ (graduate).'

a.en: 'By + future time' takes the future perfect tense.
a.as: 'by + ভৱিষ্যত সময়'ত future perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (build) this bridge in 1990.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (build) this bridge in 1990.'

a.en: 'In 1990' is a finished past time, so we use the simple past 'built'.
a.as: 'in 1990' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past 'built' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The movie ___ (start) before we reached the hall.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The movie ___ (start) before we reached the hall.'

a.en: The earlier of two past actions is in the past perfect.
a.as: দুটা অতীত কাৰ্যৰ আগত হোৱাটো past perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (write) this letter since morning.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (write) this letter since morning.'

a.en: 'Since morning' with an action still going on takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'since morning' আৰু এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'It ___ (not, rain) now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'It ___ (not, rain) now.'

a.en: The negative of the present continuous is 'is/am/are + not + ing'.
a.as: present continuousৰ নেতিবাচক ৰূপ 'is/am/are + not + ing'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'How long ___ you ___ (learn) English?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'How long ___ you ___ (learn) English?'

a.en: 'How long' asks about duration up to now, so the present perfect continuous is used.
a.as: 'how long'য়ে এতিয়ালৈকে সময় বিচাৰে, গতিকে present perfect continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'My brother ___ (play) cricket every evening.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'My brother ___ (play) cricket every evening.'

a.en: A routine with a third-person subject takes 'plays' (adds s/es).
a.as: তৃতীয় পুৰুষৰ নিয়মীয়া কামত 'plays' (s/es যোগ) হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (wash) her clothes at present.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (wash) her clothes at present.'

a.en: 'At present' shows an action happening now, so present continuous.
a.as: 'at present' এতিয়া হোৱা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The train ___ at 6 pm every day.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The train ___ at 6 pm every day.'

a.en: Fixed timetables and schedules are expressed in the simple present.
a.as: নিৰ্ধাৰিত সময়সূচী simple present tenseত প্ৰকাশ হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (not, watch) TV last night.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (not, watch) TV last night.'

a.en: 'Last night' takes the simple past negative: 'did not + watch'.
a.as: 'last night' simple past নেতিবাচক হয়: 'did not + watch'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'We ___ (live) in Assam for ten years now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'We ___ (live) in Assam for ten years now.'

a.en: 'For + period + now' shows an action continuing to the present, so the present perfect is used.
a.as: 'for + সময় + now' বৰ্তমানলৈকে চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present perfect হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Look! The boy ___ (drown)!'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'Look! The boy ___ (drown)!'

a.en: 'Look!' points to an action happening at this moment, so present continuous.
a.as: 'look!' এতিয়া হোৱা কাৰ্য নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে present continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (hear) a strange noise just now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (hear) a strange noise just now.'

a.en: 'Just now' means a moment ago, so the simple past 'heard' is used.
a.as: 'just now' অৰ্থাৎ অলপ আগতে, গতিকে simple past 'heard' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.'

a.en: A scientific fact is in the simple present tense.
a.as: বৈজ্ঞানিক তথ্য simple present tenseত হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (sleep) when the phone rang.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (sleep) when the phone rang.'

a.en: An action in progress in the past when interrupted uses the past continuous.
a.as: অতীতত চলি থকা কাৰ্যত বাধা পৰিলে past continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She has been ill ___ Monday.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She has been ill ___ Monday.'

a.en: A point of time (Monday) takes 'since' in the present perfect.
a.as: সময়ৰ বিন্দু (সোমবাৰ) present perfectত 'since' লয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'By the time we arrived, they ___ (eat) everything.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'By the time we arrived, they ___ (eat) everything.'

a.en: 'By the time + past' requires the past perfect for the earlier action.
a.as: 'by the time + অতীত'ত আগৰ কাৰ্যৰ বাবে past perfect লাগে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) over the clouds.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) over the clouds.'

a.en: 'This time tomorrow' shows an action in progress at a future time, so the future continuous.
a.as: 'this time tomorrow' ভৱিষ্যতত চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে future continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ you ever ___ (see) the Taj Mahal?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: '___ you ever ___ (see) the Taj Mahal?'

a.en: 'Ever' is used with the present perfect: 'Have + past participle'.
a.as: 'ever' present perfectৰ লগত হয়: 'Have + past participle'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (build) the road for several months.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (build) the road for several months.'

a.en: 'For + period' with an unfinished ongoing action takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'for + সময়' আৰু সমাপ্ত নোহোৱা চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I will call you as soon as I ___ (reach) home.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I will call you as soon as I ___ (reach) home.'

a.en: After 'as soon as / when / if' in a future sentence we use the present tense, not 'will'.
a.as: 'as soon as / when / if'ৰ পিছত ভৱিষ্যত বুজালেও present tense হয়, 'will' নহয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we will cancel the match.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we will cancel the match.'

a.en: In the first conditional, the 'if' clause takes the simple present and the main clause takes 'will'.
a.as: first conditionalত 'if' খণ্ডত simple present আৰু মূল বাক্যত 'will' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The earth ___ (be) round.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The earth ___ (be) round.'

a.en: A universal truth always stays in the simple present.
a.as: সাৰ্বজনীন সত্য সদায় simple present tenseত থাকে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He speaks as if he ___ everything.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He speaks as if he ___ everything.'

a.en: After 'as if / as though' we use a past tense for an unreal or imaginary comparison.
a.as: 'as if / as though'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ বা কল্পনামূলক তুলনাত past tense হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I wish I ___ (be) a bird.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I wish I ___ (be) a bird.'

a.en: After 'wish' we use the subjunctive past 'were' for unreal wishes.
a.as: 'wish'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ ইচ্ছাত subjunctive 'were' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'It is high time we ___ (go) home.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'It is high time we ___ (go) home.'

a.en: After 'It is time / high time' we use a past tense.
a.as: 'It is time / high time'ৰ পিছত past tense হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She talks as though she ___ (know) all the answers.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She talks as though she ___ (know) all the answers.'

a.en: After 'as though / as if' we use the past tense for an unreal situation.
a.as: 'as though / as if'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ পৰিস্থিতিত past tense হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (go) to Guwahati next month.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (go) to Guwahati next month.'

a.en: 'Next month' is future time, so 'will + go' is used.
a.as: 'next month' ভৱিষ্যত সময়, গতিকে 'will + go' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ she ___ (like) black tea?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: '___ she ___ (like) black tea?'

a.en: The interrogative of the simple present with 'she' uses 'Does + base verb'.
a.as: 'she'ৰ simple present প্ৰশ্নত 'Does + মূল ক্রিয়া' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (not, come) back yet.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (not, come) back yet.'

a.en: 'Yet' takes the present perfect negative: 'have not + past participle'.
a.as: 'yet' present perfect নেতিবাচক হয়: 'have not + past participle'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The children ___ (play) in the park since 4 o'clock.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The children ___ (play) in the park since 4 o'clock.'

a.en: 'Since + point of time' with a continuing action takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'since + সময় বিন্দু' আৰু চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (not, see) him since 2020.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (not, see) him since 2020.'

a.en: 'Since + point of time' in a negative sense takes the present perfect negative.
a.as: 'since + সময় বিন্দু' নেতিবাচক অৰ্থত present perfect negative হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'We ___ (know) each other for many years.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'We ___ (know) each other for many years.'

a.en: 'For + period' up to now takes the present perfect 'have known'.
a.as: 'for + সময়' এতিয়ালৈকে present perfect 'have known' হয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'While I ___ (walk) on the road, I met an old friend.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'While I ___ (walk) on the road, I met an old friend.'

a.en: 'While' introduces a longer background action, so the past continuous is used.
a.as: 'while'য়ে দীঘলীয়া পটভূমি কাৰ্য বুজায়, গতিকে past continuous হয়।
